## Decisions: what the team chose (hand-written, wins over generated facts)

## Contracts: how to reason about a failure class

Read one with `kit contract <name>` when its trigger applies.

| Contract                       | Applies when |
| ------------------------------ | ------------ |
| emit-hygiene                   | writing any code |
| lifetime-matched-injection     | registering a service, a singleton or cache, background work, subscriptions, timers, event handlers |
| logic-over-surface             | writing or reviewing a rule, contract, convention or skill |
| openapi-client-consumption     | touching a generated API client or the data it returns |
| self-descriptive-naming        | naming anything (file, project, namespace, class, method, property, variable, route) |
| commit-side-effect-order       | SaveChanges, transaction, multi-step write or delete, e-mail, message queue, HTTP call, file write, retry, background work |
| dotnet-tooling                 | using, or failing to reach, the SDK, dotnet-ef, the Roslyn language server, the Microsoft Learn or NuGet MCP server, or an official dotnet skill |
| lost-update                    | update endpoint or command, edit form, PUT/PATCH, toggle, stock or counter change, background job writing the same rows |
| migration-history              | migration, ModelSnapshot, entity or model configuration change, schema script, merge of branches that touched the model |
| nullability-across-layers      | new or changed field, nullable or required, database column, DTO, mapping, view model |
| time-kind                      | DateTime, DateTimeOffset, DateOnly, TimeOnly, a date stored as text, time zone, dates in JSON or in a query |

## Failure classes (used by the error-classifier skill)

| Signal | Route to |
| ------ | -------- |
| `DbUpdateConcurrencyException`, an edit silently overwritten, wrong counter or stock | `lost-update` |
| `NullReferenceException` far from the change, insert fails on NOT NULL, blank field | `nullability-across-layers` |
| pending model changes, migration fails elsewhere, missing column | `migration-history`, `/db-scaffold` |
| orphan rows, half-done delete, duplicate e-mail or message after a retry | `commit-side-effect-order` |
| a date off by an hour or a day, wrong date order | `time-kind` |
| "Cannot consume scoped service from singleton", "A second operation was started on this context", data of another user | `lifetime-matched-injection` |
| slow page, N+1, too many queries, cartesian explosion | the `optimizing-ef-core-queries` skill |
| SDK, dotnet-ef, LSP or MCP not starting, project can't be built here | `dotnet-tooling`, `setup` skill |
| after a .NET upgrade, obsolete API warnings | `/dotnet-upgrade` |

## Priority on conflict (say the conflict out loud, never pick silently)

1. contract  2. decisions  3. conventions  4. official .NET skills + Microsoft Learn  5. your own knowledge

## Tools: the official layer

- C# and .NET questions → the `csharp-expert` skill (dotnet plugin); refactoring → the `csharp-refactoring` skill
- EF Core queries, tracking, loading → the `optimizing-ef-core-queries` skill
- Version-dependent or API-reference questions → Microsoft Learn MCP (`microsoft-learn`): search, then fetch the page
- Package versions, compatibility, vulnerabilities → NuGet MCP (`nuget`)
- Major upgrades → `/dotnet-upgrade`, which uses the dotnet-upgrade migration skills
- Symbol, references → LSP (Roslyn); if it does not answer → grep `.claude/.state/inventory.md`
- Build and tests → the commands in workspace.md
- Webshop.Desktop: Windows-only; off Windows, build the other projects and say what was not built
- A tool not available: say so once, use the fallback, keep working.

## Freshness

- `kit stale` lists conventions that no longer match the code. Stale ⇒ say so, then run `kit scan`.

## The loop

Look up the rules → ask the official layer for framework questions → build → LSP + build/test →
run the `codecraft` skill on the diff → report what was applied, skipped, and not checkable.
